statement: For every finite Boolean core g with a source-supporting inherited normalized spectral reference R, the lifted bent carrier preserves this reference under every fair adaptive ordinary physical restriction, including reference-only rows. With K=KL(p_g||R) and M=sum_j h2(Inf_j(g)), K+M plus accumulated actual outcome KL is a supermartingale up to stopping or one final carrier/product conversion, retaining the full terminal H+KL. The least pending booking B obeys B<=M. For the explicit GF(2^l) selector stress family, every l>=2, the total original selector-root pending reserve is at most Wcap=3 for l=2 or 39l/32 for l>=3, and Wcap<13Sbar/48, where Sbar is the one original mean child (4I-H) owner. With unrelated old expenditure at most Sbar/4 and an already booked nested pending reserve theta, top up only Wcap-theta, leaving more than 23Sbar/48 in the same owner. At l=2,3 the complete optional-stop depth-two policy minimum is respectively 47/32-(3/8)log2(7) and 0; it is below Sbar/25 and its increase from depth one is below Sbar/50.

For every finite adaptive history querying only non-carrier physical coordinates of F=(-1)^((u+v+L+c)*v)g with an exactly lifted source-supporting reference, normalized reference transport commutes with the carrier lift; a later v query has eta=O_v=0. The complete pending reset booking after an ordinary query j is max(0,mean child[TC(g_child)-K_child]_+-E_j), not necessarily the old booking. On the explicit A061 l2 actual nine-bit selector parent, a G-stop/H-data0-then-v cut has exact old-bank shortfall Delta/2>11/50, Delta=-9/2+(3/8)log2(3)+(15/8)log2(5). Global reference-kernel tensor amplification is unproved and fails the naive prediction test. All30 one-data frontier cases at l2,l3 instead fit an updated TOTAL booking<S_original/50, leaving>73S_original/100 after an old quarter booking; full terminal H+TC is retained. Only the lift identity, not the small payment bound, is all-dimensional.
